summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to establish a Medicare Advance Directive Certification Program to encourage beneficiaries to adopt and maintain certified advance directives by accrediting vendors that offer these directives and providing educational resources.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly impacts healthcare by establishing a Medicare program to encourage beneficiaries to adopt advance directives, which guide their medical care decisions. It aims to improve the clarity and accessibility of patient wishes within the existing Medicare framework.
